start Mon Oct 19 12:29:28 AM AEDT 2026 maxsecs=24632 hard=25112

=== run.sh
#!/bin/sh
# p=41, N=8 derived number wall, C=1.2e7 full triangle. Stops at the first
# side-8 window, gracefully at 07:20 AEDT (checkpoint), hard kill by 07:28.
cd ~/ffl-cover/nw/run41
deadline=$(date -d "07:20" +%s); now=$(date +%s); secs=$((deadline - now)); hard=$((secs + 480))
echo "start $(date) maxsecs=$secs hard=$hard" >> guard.log
OMP_NUM_THREADS=12 timeout -s KILL $hard nice -n 10 ./nw41run 41 8 1 12000000 6000000 8 gmax=16 stop maxsecs=$secs ckpt=ckpt ckpt_secs=1800 progress=20000 > windows.out 2> progress.err &
pid=$!
while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do
  for q in $(pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -x nw41run); do
    rss=$(ps -o rss= -p $q 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
    if [ -n "$rss" ] && [ "$rss" -gt 2000000 ]; then kill $q; echo "KILLED rss=$rss $(date)" >> guard.log; fi
  done
  sleep 10
done
wait $pid; echo "exit $? $(date)" >> guard.log
=== swap.sh
#!/bin/sh
# After the first checkpoint, stop the static-chunk run and resume with run2.sh.
cd ~/ffl-cover/nw/run41
until grep -q "^checkpoint row" progress.err; do
  pgrep -x nw41run >/dev/null || { echo "swap: run ended before checkpoint $(date)" >> guard.log; exit 0; }
  sleep 5
done
pkill -x nw41run
while pgrep -x nw41run >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done
echo "swap: stopped after $(grep "^checkpoint row" progress.err | tail -1) $(date)" >> guard.log
if [ -s windows.out ]; then echo "swap: window already found; not resuming" >> guard.log; exit 0; fi
mv nw41run2 nw41run
exec ./run2.sh
=== run2.sh
#!/bin/sh
# Resume the p=41 search from ckpt with the dynamic-chunk build (same results).
# Graceful stop 07:20 AEDT (checkpoint), hard kill by 07:28.
cd ~/ffl-cover/nw/run41
deadline=$(date -d "07:20" +%s); now=$(date +%s); secs=$((deadline - now)); hard=$((secs + 480))
echo "resume $(date) maxsecs=$secs hard=$hard sha256=$(sha256sum number_wall_v2.c | cut -c1-16)" >> guard.log
OMP_NUM_THREADS=12 timeout -s KILL $hard nice -n 10 ./nw41run 41 8 1 12000000 6000000 8 gmax=16 stop maxsecs=$secs ckpt=ckpt ckpt_secs=1800 progress=20000 resume=ckpt >> windows.out 2> progress2.err &
pid=$!
while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do
  for q in $(pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -x nw41run); do
    rss=$(ps -o rss= -p $q 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
    if [ -n "$rss" ] && [ "$rss" -gt 2000000 ]; then kill $q; echo "KILLED rss=$rss $(date)" >> guard.log; fi
  done
  sleep 10
done
wait $pid; echo "exit $? $(date)" >> guard.log
